verdict.rationale: Employee referrals are a fair axis for an applicant tracking system like Greenhouse, but nothing in the evidence pack documents an employee-facing referral flow for submitting referrals or tracking their status. The candidate-ingestion API, which lets partners send candidates and retrieve stage and status, is a partner developer building block, not an employee referral feature. Source-based reporting is likewise only adjacent, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an employee, I can refer candidates through a real referral flow — submit, track status, and see where my referral stands
